subject: [PATCH v2 06/17] selftests/mm: add folio-order check for address ranges

2026-08-07.patch_summary: This patch adds a new function called `is_range_backed_by_folio_orders` to the Linux kernel's selftests/mm module. The function checks whether an address range is backed by folios of a specific order, and returns true if it is. This is useful for testing memory allocation and deallocation scenarios where folio ordering matters. The function works by checking each window of the address range to see if it maps exactly one folio of the specified order, with the first PFN being the folio head and the subsequent PFNs being contiguous. If any window fails this check, the function returns false.
